hailReplies.label: By decree of the Prime: power down and be catalogued.
Board their relay and cut the channel.

nemeses.name: Captain Ilse Marrow
nemeses.title: The Surveyor
nemeses.trait: Marksman: her fore gun reaches 5 hexes.
nemeses.tactic: Quiet Ledger keeps her bow on you and fires the Survey Driver down it. Get out of her fore arc before it fires.
nemeses.hailFirst: Sixth Verdict. I charted this reef before your Prime had a number for it. Every rock here is in my ledger. So are you, now.
nemeses.hailEscaped: You cost me {scar}. I have had it logged, costed and paid for. Shall we go again?
nemeses.hailStandoff: You ran the clock out on me. I do not mind. I am a patient woman, and yours is a slow ship.
nemeses.hailFinal: No more soundings. Quiet Ledger does not leave this time, and neither do you.
nemeses.epitaph: Quiet Ledger's charts went down with her. The Concord is sounding the Reef blind.
nemeses.retortEdict: Catalogued. I have been catalogued by better. Guns, then.
nemeses.retortFire: No preamble. Good. I dislike being read to.
nemeses.retortBoard: You cut my relay. I navigate by soundings, child. I do not need to hear my escorts to know where you are.
nemeses.retortSilence: Nothing to say? Then I will enter it as consent.

nemeses.name: Wing-Speaker Tobiah Rask
nemeses.title: The Open Hand
nemeses.trait: Wing leader: launches two gunships at a time and calls Joint Fire.
nemeses.tactic: Open Hand hangs back and fights through its gunships. Kill the wing as it launches, or go through it for the tender.
nemeses.hailFirst: Wing-Speaker Rask, for forty crews who voted to be here. Nobody voted for you. Nobody ever has, have they?
nemeses.hailEscaped: We held a count after last time: {scar}, and nine names. The vote to find you again was unanimous.
nemeses.hailStandoff: You would not finish it and neither could we. The crews want it settled. So do I.
nemeses.hailFinal: The wing has voted. No recall order this time. Whatever is left of us lands on you.
nemeses.epitaph: Forty crews are voting on who speaks for them now. It will take them days.
nemeses.retortEdict: Your Prime decrees. My crews vote. Let us see which one bleeds for it.
nemeses.retortFire: There it is. Launch everything. Everything.
nemeses.retortBoard: You have boarded my relay. Forty crews just heard their friends die on an open channel. Thank you for that.
nemeses.retortSilence: Silence. That is all your kind ever has for us.

nemeses.name: Engineer-Prime Dessa Koyl
nemeses.title: The Mender
nemeses.trait: Yard ship: thick fore plate, and she mends her escorts.
nemeses.tactic: Mender's Oath repairs whatever you leave alive and cuts anything that comes within 2 hexes. Kill the escort outright or do not start on it.
nemeses.hailFirst: Koyl, Mender's Oath. I have built better ships than yours out of worse wrecks. Hold still and I will show you how it is done.
nemeses.hailEscaped: You left me {scar}. I fixed it in a day. I keep the slag on my desk.
nemeses.hailStandoff: A draw. I do not build things to draw.
nemeses.hailFinal: I have welded the escape pods shut. Mine, not yours. Come on.
nemeses.epitaph: The Concord's yards have lost the only hand that could have rebuilt her.
nemeses.retortEdict: Power down? I have not powered down a yard in thirty years and I will not start for a number.
nemeses.retortFire: Shooting first. Sloppy. You will see what a proper weld does to a lance.
nemeses.retortBoard: My relay. That will take an hour to fix. You do not have an hour.
nemeses.retortSilence: Not a word. Fine. I will let the plate talk.

relics.name: Marrow's Ledger
relics.text: +1 command on the first turn of every battle.

relics.name: Reef Charts
relics.text: Both rival fleets move a little slower on every jump.

relics.name: The Lost Compass
relics.text: Mined lanes cost the fleet nothing.
